summary: Notes the legacy public cloud guides may be outdated and are moving into collections, with the AWS guide now in the amazon.aws collection docs.
questions: Where is the current Ansible AWS guide?
Are the Ansible public cloud scenario guides up to date?

answer_card.title: Legacy cloud guides moved to collections
answer_card.answer_md: The legacy public cloud guides may be out of date and are being migrated into their collections. The AWS guide now lives in the `amazon.aws` collection docs (`ansible_collections.amazon.aws.docsite.aws_intro`).
